method.public_name: GP Enhanced Energy Aware eNMPC with Robust SE(3) Tracking Control

required_before_any_logical_arm: new run_id and new prelaunch receipt
all method, source, configuration, GP, mission, plan and task SHA values match
one explicitly named dynamics plant owner and no second plant
single owner of the configured serial port
physical propulsion power absent and physical PWM zero
board UID, firmware SHA and required symbols verified
gpenmpc_se3_control running and RA_CTRL_MODE=1 if the admitted deployment contract uses mode 1
MATLAB/Simulink provides HIL control and orchestration; Python provides build, upload and supporting tools
runtime exposes actual eNMPC outer solve activity rather than configuration loading alone
required_runtime_evidence: solver success, failure, deadline and solve-time distribution
selected candidate and phase progress, rate and acceleration
GP inference count and adopted, downweighted and hard-invalid counts
rflysim_role: display and recording for the same run_id only; replay must not be reported as live HIL
